title: Liquid glass
description: A pill of liquid glass over a photo or video: the rim bends what is behind it like a lens (with a hint of colour fringing), the face is frosted, a lit bevel catches the light and one highlight runs round it as it settles. A prompt types into it, the send key is pressed, and the pill flows open into a card listing what happened. The premium AI-product look. Give `background` (a bin file id); without one a drawn scene sits behind.

background.description: Photo or video behind the glass (file id).

scene.description: The drawn scene behind the glass when no background is given (its colours follow the seed).

text.default: Cut a 15 second teaser from this clip

results.description: Rows the pill opens to show after send, each with a check (empty: the pill stays a pill).

frost.description: How frosted the glass face is: 0 clear, 1 fully blurred.

bend.description: How far the rim bends the background, px at 1080.
